messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT alert — high p99 CPU and memory on inference-runtime-prod when producing structured outputs / tool calls. Symptom: sustained 60% CPU above baseline on nodes serving /v1/chat with structured mode enabled. Auto-escalation to eng-oncall.

Adele (oncall): seeing it. Thanks. Confirming: increased tail latency + OOMs on a few pods. Not yet customer-facing page but errors spiking in logs.

Sara (runtime): logs show repeated large JSON emission + heavy tokenizer ops from function/tool-call flows. Looks like structured-output handlers + tool-call plumbing amplify tokenization and KV-cache churn.

Josh (sre): impact matrix? which routes/users?

Adele (oncall): preliminary: 1) /v1/chat (structured output) — 20% of requests but 50% of CPU; 2) function/tool-call enabled flows — small fraction of calls but cause high memory due to parallel tool invocations. Noted errors: 5 pod restarts in last 10m.

Emma (support): any customers affected yet? I can pre-draft comms if we need to restrict features.

Adele (oncall): Not seeing widespread 5xx to customers, mostly internal retries. But want to mitigate before it degrades. Plan: temporary mitigation - throttle structured output tokenization and disable tool/function-calling for non-enterprise tiers for the time being. Apply safe fallback: return basic text-only responses or a small structured summary.

Mike (oncall-next): +1. Need exact commands to flip. If we can do a config flag rollout that's preferable to redeploy.

Sara (runtime): We have feature-flag gate keys: feature.structured_output.mode and feature.tool_calls.enabled. Suggest: set structured_output.mode=throttle (qps cap) and feature.tool_calls.enabled=false for plan:standard and plan:free. Keep enterprise & dedicated unaffected.

Adele (oncall): executing now. Commands: ```
# throttle structured outputs to 2 QPS per route, disable tool calls for standard/free
redwoodctl config set --env prod --route /v1/chat feature.structured_output.mode=throttle
redwoodctl config set --env prod --route /v1/chat feature.structured_output.qps=2
redwoodctl config set --env prod --org-plan standard feature.tool_calls.enabled=false
redwoodctl config set --env prod --org-plan free feature.tool_calls.enabled=false
# apply route-level quota bump to avoid accidental full rate limit
redwoodctl config set --env prod --route /v1/chat rate_limit.burst=50
```

ops-bot: COMMAND accepted. Started rolling config change on 12 pods (group: inference-prod-chat). Tracking: change_id=cfg-202603151230.

Adele (oncall): pushing change_id into canary pods first. Will monitor metrics for next 5m.

ops-bot: Canary rollout complete (3/3 canaries) — no crash observed. Proceeding to bulk (9/12 updated).

Josh (sre): watching pod CPU/oom graphs now. Setting alert mute for non-critical noise.

Adele (oncall): initial telemetry after throttle: pod CPU down ~58% on updated nodes, p95 latency improved from 1100ms -> 730ms. No increase in 5xx so far.

Emma (support): drafting message: "Heads-up — temporary restriction on advanced structured responses and tool-based calls for free/standard plans while we stabilize runtime. Enterprise customers unaffected."
Emma (support): who should get the early heads-up list?

Adele (oncall): give to Support tier owners + any customers who opened severity tickets in last 24h. Also post a banner in dashboard: "Temporary feature restriction — structured outputs and tool calls limited for Standard/Free while we remediate."

Sara (runtime): Root cause hypothesis: certain prompt patterns (very large structured schemas + nested tool calls) trigger exponential KV cache growth and repeated tokenization passes. For short term we throttle; long term we need incremental streaming/early-truncation and better tool-call concurrency caps.

Mike (oncall-next): taking over watches in 15 minutes. Adele — please add handoff note with what to watch and mitigation steps.

Adele (oncall): Handoff checklist posted: "what I changed (feature flags, change_id), expected metrics (cpu p95 drop), rollback commands, runbook links." Will put in thread.

Adele (oncall): rollback commands (if needed): ```
redwoodctl config set --env prod --route /v1/chat feature.structured_output.mode=enabled
redwoodctl config set --env prod --org-plan standard feature.tool_calls.enabled=true
redwoodctl config set --env prod --org-plan free feature.tool_calls.enabled=true
```

ops-bot: Bulk rollout finished (12/12). change_id=cfg-202603151230 applied.

Josh (sre): CPU trending down cluster-wide ~50% in 12m. Memory stable, no new OOMs. Good sign.

Emma (support): posted draft to #support-templates. ETA to notify customers ~10m.

Adele (oncall): ETA hold period 30m to ensure no regressions. If stable, will move to targeted fixes: limit structured schema size, add tool-call concurrency cap, and schedule postmortem.

Mike (oncall-next): taking watch. Key things I'll watch: p95 latency, pod restarts, error-rates per-route, and any spikes in enterprise customer errors. If anything degrades, I'll escalate.

Adele (oncall): handover: change_id=cfg-202603151230, canary pods showed no crashes, bulk applied, watch list: inference-prod-chat pods (names: chat-srv-0..11), metrics dashboards linked: https://grafana.redwood/prod/inference/chat, slack alert rules muted: infra-noise-98.

SupportBot: Notifying customers on the watchlist: staging customers flagged, 4 active tickets will receive automated note.

Mike (oncall-next): acknowledged. I'll keep this thread updated. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:

Adele (oncall): quick follow-up 20m later — still stable. p95 latency 700-760ms, cpu steady. Keeping throttle in place for 1 hour, then revert to lighter limit if stable. Filing incident ticket and linking to this thread.

Adele (oncall): Incident ticket created INC-20260315-44. Assigning to runtime team for a full RCA and mitigation roadmap.

Sara (runtime): Itemizing next steps: 1) implement schema size limit (PR incoming), 2) add per-request tool-call concurrency cap (runtime change), 3) improve tokenization caching to avoid full re-tokenize for structured outputs. Will start a sprint ticket.

Mike (oncall-next): keep monitoring. If we see reappearance after un-throttle, we may need a gradual rollout of structured output improvements.

Adele (oncall): closing loop: will update postmortem template with mitigation steps used. Thanks all. :pray:

ops-bot: change_id=cfg-202603151230 — audit log: Adele executed config changes at 2026-03-15T12:30:15Z.

Adele (oncall): thread closed for active mitigation. If anything pops, ping me and I can reopen.

Mike (oncall-next): noted. Reopening will re-run the rollout notes. :eyes:
